The '''korrinas'''<ref name="Asha" /> or '''corrinas'''<ref name="Essential Guide">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> were a [[Wolf/Legends|wolf]]-like<ref>{{DB|1=character|2=asha|3=Asha}}</ref> canine predator found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Asha" /> A very smart species, Korrinas naturally traveled in packs, and were particularly active during the winter months.<ref name="Creatures of Endor">{{SWArchive|url=kids/explore/eu/f20041123|text="Creatures of Endor"}}</ref> Young korrinas had ligther fur and a shorter tail.<ref name="Asha" />

A group of these creatures raised the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] warrior [[Asha/Legends|Asha]] after she was separated from her mother, [[Ra-Lee/Legends|Ra-Lee]], by a [[hanadak]] attack.<ref name="Asha" />
